"""Date parsing for invoice imports."""

import re

# Accepted formats (see app/formats.py):
#   YYYY-MM-DD  (ISO)
#   YYYY/MM/DD  (US exports)
#   DD.MM.YYYY  (European exports: day first)
_YEAR_FIRST = re.compile(r"^(\d{4})([-/])(\d{1,2})\2(\d{1,2})$")
_DAY_FIRST = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$")


def parse_date(text):
    """Parse an import date into a (year, month, day) tuple of ints."""
    s = text.strip()
    m = _YEAR_FIRST.match(s)
    if m:
        year, month, day = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(3)), int(m.group(4))
    else:
        m = _DAY_FIRST.match(s)
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported date format: {text!r}")
        day, month, year = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
    if not (1 <= month <= 12 and 1 <= day <= 31):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid date: {text!r}")
    return (year, month, day)

arguments.content:
"""Date parsing for invoice imports."""

import re

# Accepted formats (see app/formats.py):
#   YYYY-MM-DD  (ISO)
#   YYYY/MM/DD  (US exports)
#   DD.MM.YYYY  (European exports: day first)
_YEAR_FIRST = re.compile(r"^(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})$")
_DAY_FIRST = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})$")


def parse_date(text):
    """Parse an import date into a (year, month, day) tuple of ints."""
    s = text.strip()
    m = _YEAR_FIRST.match(s)
    if m:
        # Require a consistent separator (no "2026-03/05").
        if s[4] != s[4 + 1 + len(m.group(2))]:
            raise ValueError(f"unsupported date format: {text!r}")
        year, month, day = m.groups()
    else:
        m = _DAY_FIRST.match(s)
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"unsupported date format: {text!r}")
        day, month, year = m.groups()
    return (int(year), int(month), int(day))
